reason: Grafana opens its MySQL connection with clientFoundRows=true (pkg/services/sqlstore/sqlstore.go:287), so RowsAffected() counts rows the UPDATE matched, not only rows it changed. A matching device with unchanged values therefore returns 1, and updateDevice in pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/anonstore/database.go:108 does not wrongly return ErrDeviceLimitReached.
